provenance.authors: Prathik R. Kaundinya, Kamal Choudhary, Surya R. Kalidindi
provenance.channel: edos_up only; normalized electronic spin-up DOS, not phonons or spin-summed DOS
provenance.processing: 300 samples: -5 inclusive to 10 exclusive, spacing 0.05 eV relative to Fermi; integrals restricted to sampled support [-5, 9.95]; unit-area normalization; fixed integrals/moments; arithmetic mean across all valid composition-matched structures
provenance.limitations: Reference structures are NOT verified source phases; no guessed structure, phase selection, graph embedding, carrier density, measured HTEM film data, or inferred mixture DOS. Missing compositions remain missing; across-reference spread is not calibrated uncertainty.
